newsitem.title: USA: Rodney King launches music company - radio.
newsitem.headline: Rodney King launches music company - radio.

text.p: Rodney King, which received $3.8 million in a civil suit triggered by his infamous 1991 videotaped beating, has now become president of his own music label, according to Thursday radio reports.
Acquittal of four police officers accused in King's beating sparked violent riots throughout Los Angeles in the spring of 1992 that resulted in more than 50 deaths.
Radio station KFWB in Los Angeles said Thursday that King has left a self-imposed isolation to launch a rap record company called Straight Alta-Pazz.
King is also planning to hold a swanky celebration around July 4, charging $40 to $75 per guest, to celebrate the release of his first compact disc.
Neither King or the company could be reached for comment.
